_comment: Each reference example's architecture and, when one exists, the CATEGORY A loom-fun package (card made by the current skill) that is its port: that package's llm_config.json is the example's reviewed config (apply_example.sh CFG merges it; find_reference.py maps the package back to this kit). Pinned revisions keep apply_example.sh reproducible; check_examples.sh verifies each is category A and of the example's architecture. An example without a category A package keeps its cfg.json. "archs": further architectures the example kit ports (port.sh applies it to a GGUF of any of them; its reviewed config is never merged into those).
